title: Thai-Style Chicken Skewers
description: Spicy and tangy, these Thai-style chicken skewers are a refreshing twist on traditional grilled chicken. Marinated in a blend of Thai spices, they're perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: 2. In a blender or food processor, combine hot sauce, fish sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and lemon juice. Blend until smooth.
3. Thread chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
4. Brush coconut oil onto both sides of the chicken.
5. Place skewers on the grill and cook for 8-10 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through.
6. During the last 2-3 minutes of cooking, brush the skewers with the blended sauce.
7. Remove skewers from the grill and let rest for a few minutes.
8. If using, sprinkle crumbled portuguese cheese over the top of the chicken.
